test.create_query: CREATE TABLE external_sort_hits_mark ENGINE = Memory AS SELECT now64(6) AS t
test.fill_query: SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(cityHash64(rowNumberInAllBlocks(), WatchID, EventTime))) != ( SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(rowNumberInAllBlocks(), WatchID, EventTime)) FROM (SELECT WatchID, EventTime FROM hits_100m_single ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_sort = 0))) FROM (SELECT WatchID, EventTime FROM hits_100m_single ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_sort = 500000000, log_comment = 'external_sort_hits.q0'

WITH (SELECT groupArray(URL) FROM (SELECT URL FROM hits_100m_single ORDER BY URL LIMIT 10 OFFSET 10000000)) AS r SELECT throwIf(length(r) != 10 OR countIf(URL < r[1]) > 10000000 OR r != arraySlice(arraySort(groupArrayIf(URL, URL >= r[1] AND URL <= r[10])), 10000001 - countIf(URL < r[1]), 10)) FROM hits_100m_single SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_sort = 1000000000, log_comment = 'external_sort_hits.q1'

WITH (SELECT groupArray((EventTime, WatchID)) FROM (SELECT WatchID, EventTime FROM hits_100m_single ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID LIMIT 1000000)) AS r SELECT throwIf(length(r) != 1000000 OR r != arraySlice(arraySort(groupArrayIf((EventTime, WatchID), (EventTime, WatchID) <= r[-1])), 1, 1000000)) FROM hits_100m_single SETTINGS log_comment = 'external_sort_hits.q2'

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(cityHash64(rowNumberInAllBlocks(), WatchID, EventTime))) != ( SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(rowNumberInAllBlocks(), WatchID, EventTime)) FROM (SELECT WatchID, EventTime FROM hits_10m_single ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_sort = 0)) OR sum(cityHash64(WatchID, EventTime, UserID, CounterID, URL, Title, Referer, SearchPhrase)) != (SELECT sum(cityHash64(WatchID, EventTime, UserID, CounterID, URL, Title, Referer, SearchPhrase)) FROM hits_10m_single)) FROM (SELECT WatchID, EventTime, UserID, CounterID, URL, Title, Referer, SearchPhrase FROM hits_10m_single ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_sort = 100000000, log_comment = 'external_sort_hits.q3'

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(cityHash64(rowNumberInAllBlocks(), WatchID, EventTime))) != ( SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(rowNumberInAllBlocks(), WatchID, EventTime)) FROM ( SELECT WatchID, EventTime FROM hits_10m_single ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_sort = 0, max_bytes_ratio_before_external_sort = 0))) FROM (SELECT WatchID, EventTime FROM hits_10m_single ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_sort = 10000000, max_bytes_ratio_before_external_sort = 0.0003, log_comment = 'external_sort_hits.q4'

SELECT throwIf(groupArray((log_comment, ProfileEvents['ExternalSortWritePart'] > 0)) != [ ('external_sort_hits.q0', 1), ('external_sort_hits.q1', 1), ('external_sort_hits.q2', 0), ('external_sort_hits.q3', 1), ('external_sort_hits.q4', 1)], 'the setup runs of the measured queries are not in query_log, or their spills differ') FROM ( SELECT log_comment, read_rows, ProfileEvents FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND log_comment LIKE 'external_sort_hits.q%' AND query_start_time_microseconds >= (SELECT t FROM external_sort_hits_mark) ORDER BY event_time_microseconds )
test.query: SELECT WatchID, EventTime FROM hits_100m_single ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_sort = 500000000
SELECT URL FROM hits_100m_single ORDER BY URL LIMIT 10 OFFSET 10000000 FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_sort = 1000000000
SELECT WatchID, EventTime FROM hits_100m_single ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID LIMIT 1000000 FORMAT Null
SELECT WatchID, EventTime, UserID, CounterID, URL, Title, Referer, SearchPhrase FROM hits_10m_single ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_sort = 100000000
SELECT WatchID, EventTime FROM hits_10m_single ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_bytes_before_external_sort = 10000000, max_bytes_ratio_before_external_sort = 0.0003
test.drop_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS external_sort_hits_mark SYNC
